title: Load Control Officer
description:
We at PNG Air pride ourselves as the leading domestic airline operating to 24 ports across the length and breadth of Papua New Guinea as the Airline of Choice. Operating the largest fleet of ATR 72-600 series in the region.
We are committed to providing affordable world-class experience with value fares and unbeatable cargo rates, ensuring reliable and safe on time service to our valued customers and stakeholders.
Load Control Officer
We are seeking a Load Control Officer to coordinate aircraft loading, prepare Load and Trim sheets, communicate with the Ramp Supervisor and Captain, and optimize cargo operations at Port Moresby.
Key responsibilities include:
Ensure communication with the Ramp Supervisor with regards to the loading and unloading of the aeroplane;
Produce Load and Trim sheets;
Liaise with the aeroplane Captain regarding fuel uplift; and
Liaise with the cargo department regarding cargo uplift considering maximization and prioritization of goods to uplift.
Qualifications/Experiences:
Educated up to minimum of Grade 12;
Tertiary qualification would be considered ideal;
Quick learning skills;
Be able to understand and communicate with people; and
Have good computer, customer skills and mathematical skills.
If you are interested and meet the minimum requirement, please forward your resume and a cover letter to:
[email protected]
Please send in all applications in only one PDF file.
Applications close: Friday 07th November 2025.
